title: fix(xo-collection): emit remove on the previous type when an indexed item changes type

files.patch:
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@
 
 - [Backups/Merge] The background merge no longer crashes with `ENAMETOOLONG` when a VM's backups are locked by another job: it waits 5 minutes before trying again instead of retrying in a loop (PR [#10866](https://github.com/vatesfr/xen-orchestra/pull/10866))
 - [V2V] When the import of a disk fails before its transfer starts, the task shows the reason given by the migration engine (e.g. `could not connect: timed out`) instead of `stream has ended without data, was looking for 8 bytes` (PR [#10842](https://github.com/vatesfr/xen-orchestra/pull/10842))
+- [XO6] A VM converted into a template no longer stays in the VM list and treeview, contribution by [@pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333), fixes issue [#10717](https://github.com/vatesfr/xen-orchestra/issues/10717) (PR [#10884](https://github.com/vatesfr/xen-orchestra/pull/10884))

+  it('emits remove on the previous type when an item changes type', function () {
+    const removed = []
+    const updated = []
+    byGroup.getEventEmitterByType('foo').on('remove', (_, prev) => removed.push(prev))
+    byGroup.getEventEmitterByType('foo').on('update', value => updated.push(value))

+  it('emits remove on the previous type when an item no longer has a type', function () {
+    const removed = []
+    byGroup.getEventEmitterByType('foo').on('remove', (_, prev) => removed.push(prev))

+    col.update({ id: item1.id })
+
+    return waitTicks().then(() => {
+      assert.deepEqual(removed, [item1])
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('emits update, not remove, when an item keeps the same type', function () {
+    const removed = []
+    const updated = []
+    const ee = byGroup.getEventEmitterByType('foo')
+    ee.on('remove', (_, prev) => removed.push(prev))
+    ee.on('update', (value, prev) => updated.push([value, prev]))
+
+    const item1bis = {
+      id: item1.id,
+      group: 'foo',
+      newProp: true,
+    }
+    col.update(item1bis)
+
+    return waitTicks().then(() => {
+      assert.deepEqual(removed, [])
+      assert.deepEqual(updated, [[item1bis, item1]])
+    })
+  })
